text:
liza_support: Heads-up — ACME opened two tickets that look like duplicates of #3421. Links: https://support.example.com/tickets/9987 and https://support.example.com/tickets/9992. Proposing we merge into canonical #3421 and notify ACME. @jason_pm @mike_eng any objections?

jason_pm: Can you paste a 1‑line diff for 9987 vs 3421? I remember 3421 was per-route rate limits + UI.

liza_support: Quick summary: 9987 asks for a per-route burst window (avoid global throttle during batch jobs). 9992 requests an API param to set per-route burst/limit. 3421 already includes per-route limits and a console design. I'll copy the exact excerpts below.

liza_support: ```
9987 excerpt: "Need per-route burst window to avoid global throttling when jobs spike; backend + API change requested."
9992 excerpt: "API: add route_level.burst_seconds and route_level.tokens to allow per-route config."
```

mike_eng: Both map to the same backend story. If we merge, we must preserve UI vs API acceptance criteria. Ballpark effort: backend + KV sync + rollout safety = ~2 sprints; console work = 1 sprint. Risk: migration + default semantics.

sarah_p: My proposal: merge 9987 & 9992 into canonical issue 3421. Set status=triaged, priority=high (ACME is paying), owner=@mike_eng. Add acceptance criteria for API + console, and require a canary rollout with traffic split. We should send ACME a one‑paragraph update this week.

oliver_sales: :thumbsup: When you notify ACME, include an ETA range and the expected impact (what will and won't be covered in MVP). Sales will confirm funding line.

liza_support: Draft message to customer: "Thanks — we're consolidating your requests into a single roadmap item (#3421). Next steps: triage & estimate; we'll share an ETA after scoping. We'll include both the UI and API asks in the acceptance criteria. If you'd like, we can discuss prioritization and potential funded work. — Liza"

jason_pm: Add issue labels: customer:acme, duplicate:merged, canonical:#3421. Also add funding:unknown for now until sales confirms.

triage-bot: Label update: customer:acme, duplicate:merged, canonical:#3421, priority:high. Assigned to mike_eng. :white_check_mark:

mike_eng: Got it — assigned. I'll split 3421 into subtasks (backend API, console, rollout) and post estimates by EOD Friday.

liza_support: Thanks — I'll send the draft to ACME after you publish estimates. Keeping thread here for status updates.
